source.title: Introduction
source.description: Getting-started entry point for the web-data API: `search`, `scrape`, and `interact` primitives returning LLM-ready markdown/JSON, plus MCP-server and `firecrawl-cli` setup for coding agents and Python/Node SDKs.

source.title: Build with AI
source.description: AI-agent onboarding: install skills via `firecrawl-cli init`, get credentials through dashboard/CLI or WorkOS ID-JAG, drive the `search`/`scrape`/`crawl`/`map`/`interact` tools, self-recover via `/support/ask`, plus MCP server and `llms.txt` docs.

source.title: Firecrawl MCP Server
source.description: Client setup for Cursor, Claude Code/Desktop, VS Code, and n8n via the keyless hosted `mcp.firecrawl.dev` URL or local `npx firecrawl-mcp`; catalogs scrape, map, search, crawl, extract, agent, and interact tools.

source.title: Skills + CLI
source.description: Every `firecrawl` subcommand (`scrape`, `search`, `map`, `crawl`, `interact`, `monitor`, `agent`) plus `login` auth, keyless free tier, JSON `--schema` extraction, self-hosted `--api-url`, and `firecrawl-cli init` to install skills into coding agents.

source.title: Advanced Scraping Guide
source.description: Complete option reference across `/scrape`, `/crawl`, `/map`, and async `/v2/agent` endpoints: `formats` (`json`, `screenshot`), sequential browser `actions`, PDF `parsers` modes, `onlyMainContent` tag filtering, sitemap crawl scope, and `FirecrawlAgent` whitelisting.

source.title: Python
source.description: `firecrawl-py` reference covering sync `Firecrawl` and `AsyncFirecrawl` clients, `scrape`, `crawl`, `parse` methods, `PaginationConfig` auto-pagination, `watcher` job monitoring, and cloud browser sessions with CDP Playwright control.
